title: Even the Water Burned
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The people had forgotten God
for one who was not there.
Elijah gathered them up high:
“Let’s see who hears a prayer!”

[Chorus]
There’s only one true God, my love;
Heavenly Father’s true.
He’s stronger than pretend; we choose
Him first in all we do.

[Verse 2]
The others called and called all day;
no answer was returned.
Elijah soaked his altar, prayed,
then fire fell; water burned!

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes; the fire is out,
the mountain’s dark and still.
The real God watches over you
and always, always will.

[Chorus]
mood: Mountain music. A broad, slow swell under the voice, wide enough for a crowd on a hilltop, rising with quiet strength at each chorus as if the sky itself is answering. The pulse stays steady and sure, never rushed, to match a God who is real and calm. By the last verse the swell drops low and slow, the fire gone to embers and the mountain hushed.
